name: 26227-shortchat-qwen306b-1gpu
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, warmup the first 30% by request count, bounded at 4096 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, chat-formatted (`request_format: default-template`), prompt EXACTLY 128 tokens and output EXACTLY 32 tokens, min = max on both, greedy.
purpose: A small chat helper returning short single-turn replies to 64 simultaneous users on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enforce-eager: false
